---- MODULE GermanData ----
EXTENDS GermanDataDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL AgentTL == INSTANCE TLAPS

Agent_TypeOK ==
    /\ cache \in [NODE -> [state : {"I", "S", "E"}, data : DATA \cup {NoData}]]
    /\ chan1 \in [NODE -> [cmd : {"Empty", "ReqS", "ReqE"}, data : DATA \cup {NoData}]]
    /\ chan2 \in [NODE -> [cmd : {"Empty", "Inv", "GntS", "GntE"}, data : DATA \cup {NoData}]]
    /\ chan3 \in [NODE -> [cmd : {"Empty", "InvAck"}, data : DATA \cup {NoData}]]
    /\ invSet \in SUBSET NODE
    /\ shrSet \in SUBSET NODE
    /\ exGntd \in BOOLEAN
    /\ curCmd \in {"Empty", "ReqS", "ReqE"}
    /\ curPtr \in (NODE \cup {NoNode})
    /\ memData \in (DATA \cup {NoData})
    /\ auxData \in (DATA \cup {NoData})

Agent_AuxInvCache == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i].cmd = "Inv" => cache[i].state \in {"S", "E"}
Agent_AuxInvAckCache == \A i \in NODE : chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck" => cache[i].state = "I"
Agent_AuxInvShr == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i].cmd = "Inv" => i \in shrSet
Agent_AuxGntShr == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i].cmd \in {"GntS", "GntE"} => i \in shrSet
Agent_AuxInvAckShr == \A i \in NODE : chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck" => i \in shrSet
Agent_AuxInvSubset == invSet \subseteq shrSet
Agent_AuxInvNotIn == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i].cmd = "Inv" => i \notin invSet
Agent_AuxInvAckNotIn == \A i \in NODE : chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck" => i \notin invSet
Agent_AuxEEx == \A i \in NODE : cache[i].state = "E" => exGntd = TRUE
Agent_AuxGntEEx == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i].cmd = "GntE" => exGntd = TRUE
Agent_AuxGntSNoEx == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i].cmd = "GntS" => exGntd = FALSE
Agent_AuxSNoEx == \A i \in NODE : cache[i].state = "S" => exGntd = FALSE
Agent_AuxMemData == memData \in DATA
Agent_AuxAuxData == auxData \in DATA
Agent_AuxINoData == \A i \in NODE : cache[i].state = "I" => cache[i].data = NoData
Agent_AuxChan1Data == \A i \in NODE : chan1[i].data = NoData
Agent_AuxChan2EmptyNoData == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i].cmd = "Empty" => chan2[i].data = NoData
Agent_AuxChan2InvNoData == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i].cmd = "Inv" => chan2[i].data = NoData
Agent_AuxGntData == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i].cmd \in {"GntS", "GntE"} => chan2[i].data \in DATA
Agent_AuxChan3EmptyNoData == \A i \in NODE : chan3[i].cmd = "Empty" => chan3[i].data = NoData
Agent_AuxGntEqMem == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i].cmd \in {"GntS", "GntE"} => chan2[i].data = memData
Agent_AuxGntEqAux == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i].cmd \in {"GntS", "GntE"} => chan2[i].data = auxData
Agent_AuxInvAckValid == \A i \in NODE : chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck" => chan3[i].data \in {NoData, auxData}
Agent_AuxShrPending == \A i \in NODE : i \in shrSet => (cache[i].state \in {"S", "E"} \/ chan2[i].cmd \in {"GntS", "GntE", "Inv"} \/ chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck")
Agent_AuxInvCur == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i].cmd = "Inv" => curCmd # "Empty"
Agent_AuxInvAckCur == \A i \in NODE : chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck" => curCmd # "Empty"
Agent_AuxCurEmptyNoInv == (curCmd = "Empty") => (\A i \in NODE : chan2[i].cmd # "Inv" /\ chan3[i].cmd # "InvAck")
Agent_AuxInvAckNoExNoData == \A i \in NODE : (chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck" /\ exGntd = FALSE) => chan3[i].data = NoData
Agent_AuxInvAckExAux == \A i \in NODE : (chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck" /\ exGntd = TRUE) => chan3[i].data = auxData
Agent_AuxExOne == (exGntd = TRUE) => (\E i \in NODE : (cache[i].state = "E" \/ chan2[i].cmd = "GntE" \/ (chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck" /\ chan3[i].data # NoData)) /\ (\A j \in NODE \ {i} : cache[j].state # "E" /\ chan2[j].cmd # "GntE" /\ ~(chan3[j].cmd = "InvAck" /\ chan3[j].data # NoData)))
Agent_AuxNoExNo == (exGntd = FALSE) => (\A i \in NODE : cache[i].state # "E" /\ chan2[i].cmd # "GntE" /\ ~(chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck" /\ chan3[i].data # NoData))
Agent_AuxENoGntSelf == \A i \in NODE : ~(cache[i].state = "E" /\ chan2[i].cmd \in {"GntS", "GntE"})
Agent_AuxENoInvAckSelf == \A i \in NODE : ~(cache[i].state = "E" /\ chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck")
Agent_AuxInvInvAckExcl == \A i \in NODE : ~(chan2[i].cmd = "Inv" /\ chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck")
Agent_AuxGntInvAckExcl == \A i \in NODE : ~(chan2[i].cmd \in {"GntS", "GntE"} /\ chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck")
Agent_AuxGntENoS == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i].cmd = "GntE" => (\A j \in NODE : cache[j].state # "S")
Agent_AuxGntENoInvAck == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i].cmd = "GntE" => (\A j \in NODE : chan3[j].cmd # "InvAck")
Agent_AuxGntNoE == (\E i \in NODE : chan2[i].cmd \in {"GntS", "GntE"}) => (\A j \in NODE : cache[j].state # "E")
Agent_AuxPendingPtr == (curCmd # "Empty") => (curPtr \in NODE)
Agent_AuxGntECacheI == \A i \in NODE : chan2[i].cmd = "GntE" => cache[i].state = "I"
Agent_AuxReqSNoExNoInv == ((curCmd = "ReqS" /\ exGntd = FALSE) => (\A i \in NODE : chan2[i].cmd # "Inv" /\ chan3[i].cmd # "InvAck"))

Agent_IndFull ==
    /\ Agent_TypeOK
    /\ TransactionConsistency
    /\ DirectoryAccurate
    /\ ExclusiveIsolation
    /\ WritebackCarriesLatest
    /\ DataProp
    /\ Agent_AuxInvCache
    /\ Agent_AuxInvAckCache
    /\ Agent_AuxInvShr
    /\ Agent_AuxGntShr
    /\ Agent_AuxInvAckShr
    /\ Agent_AuxInvSubset
    /\ Agent_AuxInvNotIn
    /\ Agent_AuxInvAckNotIn
    /\ Agent_AuxEEx
    /\ Agent_AuxGntEEx
    /\ Agent_AuxGntSNoEx
    /\ Agent_AuxSNoEx
    /\ Agent_AuxMemData
    /\ Agent_AuxAuxData
    /\ Agent_AuxINoData
    /\ Agent_AuxChan1Data
    /\ Agent_AuxChan2EmptyNoData
    /\ Agent_AuxChan2InvNoData
    /\ Agent_AuxGntData
    /\ Agent_AuxChan3EmptyNoData
    /\ Agent_AuxGntEqMem
    /\ Agent_AuxGntEqAux
    /\ Agent_AuxInvAckValid
    /\ Agent_AuxShrPending
    /\ Agent_AuxInvCur
    /\ Agent_AuxInvAckCur
    /\ Agent_AuxCurEmptyNoInv
    /\ Agent_AuxInvAckNoExNoData
    /\ Agent_AuxInvAckExAux
    /\ Agent_AuxExOne
    /\ Agent_AuxNoExNo
    /\ Agent_AuxENoGntSelf
    /\ Agent_AuxENoInvAckSelf
    /\ Agent_AuxInvInvAckExcl
    /\ Agent_AuxGntInvAckExcl
    /\ Agent_AuxGntENoS
    /\ Agent_AuxGntENoInvAck
    /\ Agent_AuxGntNoE
    /\ Agent_AuxPendingPtr
    /\ Agent_AuxGntECacheI
    /\ Agent_AuxReqSNoExNoInv
